name: @repo/vespin-cli
description: Vespin's command-line tool, `vespin`: a first-party client of the hosted API for people in a terminal and for coding agents calling from a shell

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/vespin.mjs --define:process.env.APP_CLI_VERSION='"'$npm_package_version'"' --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
